policy: V1.3 Phase 3 preserves the Phase 2 selected-source decisions and adds only DB-GPT core/AWEL plus one PandasAI community Sandbox source file. Every direct runtime is exact-revision, path, license and checksum locked. DB-GPT app/RAG/auth/datasource surfaces and all PandasAI ee paths remain excluded. No reviewed UI, logo, model credential, database connector or restricted asset is vendored.

projects.file_headers: Two core/wren Python files are copied byte-identically on canonical LF content; Git blobs and raw/destination SHA-256 values are locked in backend/app/semantic_runtime/_upstream/provenance.json
allowed_usage: independent service or package after separate dependency review

projects.name: IBM Text-to-SQL Evaluation Toolkit
projects.subdirectory_license: PASS_SELECTED_SOURCE: all executable selected files carry IBM Copyright and SPDX Apache-2.0; evaluation/__init__.py has no competing notice and is governed by the root Apache-2.0 LICENSE. BLOCKED_PACKAGE: pyproject.toml and built wheel/sdist metadata declare MIT.

Offline evaluation of already executed and Oracle-checked ChatBI results

database credentials, Provider keys, UI, logos and trademarks

projects.name: DB-GPT
projects.subdirectory_license: Root MIT applies to packages/dbgpt-core; dbgpt-app, datasource, RAG, auth, conversation, embedded skills and assets are not selected
projects.file_headers: No DB-GPT source is copied. The exact git/archive install provenance is verified from direct_url.json; the root MIT notice is retained in the adapter package.

projects.runtime_call_scope: Phase 3 real direct AWEL entry and selected-orchestrator bridge smoke; final evidence records aggregate calls
projects.fallback: Fail closed with zero upstream calls; optional ChatBI DATA_QUERY fallback is separately labelled and still uses Guard/Executor/Oracle

projects.name: PandasAI

forbidden_paths: root pandasai import closure that loads EE
projects.runtime_call_scope: Phase 3 real inherited Sandbox.execute bridge smoke; final evidence records aggregate calls
